{{Quote|Come take a trip to the fabulous frozen plains of Hoth. Explore the beautiful ice caves, enjoy an exhilarating ride on a tauntaun, or hit the slopes for the best skiing in the Galaxy. For those with an adventurous streak you can test your skills as you go big game hunting for the elusive and deadly wampa. Whatever thrills you seek, Hoth is the one destination that delivers for the entire family!|A Hoth Travel Advertisement|<ref name="SWG:TCOA">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref>}}
'''''Hoth Travel Advertisement''''' was a title of an advertisement [[Painting/Legends|poster]] which sought to lure [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] to the dangerous [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. It was similar to the ''[[Mustafar Travel Advertisement]]''.

==Depiction==
The poster depicted three [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] tourists posing on the icy plains of Hoth. The [[Aurebesh/Legends|aurebesh]] text read, "Hoth, The Frozen Beauty."

==Behind the scenes==
A ''Hoth Travel Advertisement'' is a decorative item in the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' which players could obtain for a limited period of time from [[May 15]], [[2009]] through [[June 15]], [[2009]] in a ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]'' scenario.
